text:
maria: Quick sync — changelog cutover for SDK/quickstarts in ~48h. Need final PRs merged + docs updates. Please reply with one-line status + owners for any remaining deps. @alex @sophie @jamal

alex: Code review backlog: 3 SDK PRs I picked up. Short list:
```
- github.com/rw/sdk/pull/412
- github.com/rw/sdk/pull/418
- github.com/rw/sdk/pull/421
```
I'll take 412 & 418 today. /421 needs runtime API eyes from @tony. CI is green except an intermittent integration flake.

sophie: Sampleapps update: voice sample failing staging due to model artifact path change (mount error). Assigning follow-up to @maria and @jamal to confirm new path and bump sampleapp image.

jamal: I can patch the sampleapp today. Need the new artifact URL from infra. @devops / @infra any visibility on artifact rename?

tony: Runtime API tweak noticed in the interface PR — small change required in PR421. I'll post a minimal diff, ETA ~3h. @alex ping me if you want to pair.

maria: Docs quickstarts are mostly ready; I'll merge after Alex's PRs land. Also add a short changelog note about the batching flag rename (important for users).

dev-rel-bot: :bell: Reminder: changelog lock in 6h. Create final release draft here: https://github.com/rw/docs/releases

alex: Quick update: merged /412 and /418. /421 still pending review from @tony — CI rerun queued after last fix.

tony: Reviewed /421, left one nit about null-safety handling. Approving after that tiny fix.

jamal: Sampleapp fix pushed & CI green. Artifact URL is: gs://rw-artifacts/samples/v2/weights.tar.gz — patched path in sampleapp config and bumped image tag.

sophie: Verified staging run with Jamal's patch — voice sample tests passing. Marking sampleapps as done on my side.

maria: Nice. Final checklist for cutover:
1) Tony approves PR421
2) Docs merged + quickstart snippets updated
3) Changelog note added (batching flag rename)
4) Release draft created by @maria or @dev-rel-bot
Any blockers?

alex: No blockers from SDK side. Will standby in case Tony wants pairing.

tony: Done — approved /421 and pushed a tiny follow-up fix. Sorry for the delay.

maria: Thanks everyone. I'll cut the changelog at +6h unless anyone calls a blocker. If something comes up, drop a note here. :shipit:
